verdict.rationale: Bruno AI generates tests from a description: in the Tests tab you click the AI icon, describe what to assert, and review the generated code. It also offers ghost-text suggestions in the Tests editor, and its use-case docs describe generating collections with test cases from backend source code. However, nothing documents generating tests from an API spec (e.g. OpenAPI) or from captured responses, which is what the story specifies, so this is partial rather than full. missing for 10: documented test/assertion generation from an OpenAPI/spec definition, documented generation grounded in actual endpoint responses, independent or hands-on corroboration of output quality.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have AI generate test cases or assertions for an endpoint from its spec or responses

citations.quote: Open the Tests tab, click the AI icon, and describe what to assert. Bruno generates test code that you can review before accepting.
Ghost-text suggestions appear as you type in Pre-Request, Post-Response, and Tests script editors.
Generate Bruno collections – Create API collections from your backend source code with requests, tests, and documentation.
